 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7ad04219.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    div_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in divider_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in divider_cols]
    divider = Counter(div_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts = [-1] + [r for r in divider_rows if grid[r][0] == divider] + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + [c for c in divider_cols if grid[0][c] == divider] + [w]
    ordinary = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != divider]
    background = Counter(ordinary).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark_counts = Counter(v for v in ordinary if v != background)
    marker = mark_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_cuts, row_cuts[1:]):
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_cuts, col_cuts[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
